snapshot.description: Each snapshot represents a single UTC calendar day (00:00:00Z to 23:59:59Z).

collection.description: Collection runs after the UTC day ends to capture complete day's data.
collection.rationale: Allows time for NVD/CISA/GitHub to publish/modify records for the previous UTC day.

idempotency.description: Running multiple times for the same date produces identical output.
idempotency.deduplication: CVE ID for vulnerabilities, owner/repo for GitHub, GUID/URL for RSS
